sections.text:
L Z92 is high-speed distance relay (static relay) but switched distance relay 
with three time stepped zones. The relay is used as backup to a backup function 
of the distance relay L Z96. The relay provides three pole tripping output for 
all faults, the first zone can either be disable or time delayed so that three 
pole tripping is not interfering with L Z96 single pole tripping (Device No. 21B 
/ 21GB).

The first draft initiated by eng Mohamed Mostafa from ME, The document tested at 21 Jan
01 at 
High Dam PP. by eng. Abdel Hafiz frghaly and approved at 4 Dec.
2001 also tested at Samalout 500kv, 27 April 02 and approved 27 July 02 by eng.
Mohamed Mostafa.

Protection | Technical Procedure
Introduction
L Z92 is high-speed distance relay (static relay) but switched distance relay 
with three time stepped zones. The relay is used as backup to a backup function 
of the distance relay L Z96. The relay provides three pole tripping output for 
all faults, the first zone can either be disable or time delayed so that three 
pole tripping is not interfering with L Z96 single pole tripping (Device No. 21B 
/ 21GB).
The first draft initiated by eng Mohamed Mostafa from ME, The document tested at 21 Jan
01 at 
High Dam PP. by eng. Abdel Hafiz frghaly and approved at 4 Dec.
2001 also tested at Samalout 500kv, 27 April 02 and approved 27 July 02 by eng.
Mohamed Mostafa.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category
Safety 
 fence with caution marks surrounding 
 the work area is required.
Make sure CT secondary circuits are 
 shorted and VT secondary circuits are open.
